newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo Sept tea auction average price hits record.
newsitem.headline: Colombo Sept tea auction average price hits record.

text.p: Sri Lanka's monthly tea auction average price rose to a record 117.85 rupees per kg in September from 108.63 rupees in August, brokers Forbes and Walker said on Wednesday.
"It was because of a classic combination of sustained demand and restricted volume," said an executive at brokers Forbes and Walker.
The previous record was in August.
Prices at the Colombo auction, the world's biggest tea auction, have also been consistently higher than at other auction centres, the Forbes official said.
"It may be because the unique mix of teas offered in Colombo may not easily be supplied by other producers," he said.
Demand for Sri Lanka's distinct low grown teas, mainly from the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) and the Middle East, has kept prices at high levels.
Tea prices started shooting up in November last year, propelled mainly by heavy CIS buying for the winter.
